svg.text: Four wheels rolling on the number line
Each wheel has one mark. It touches down every p steps — and where it touches, the number is composite.
A position no mark touches is OPEN. Open is a candidate, not a guarantee.
grey = struck by a wheel you carry · green = open and prime · red = open and composite
Wheel p strikes nothing new below p² — so four wheels are exact until 121, and 121 is where that stops.
